g.text: Schema: documents, the append-only operations log, and snapshots
Every hot-path read is a range scan on (document_id, seq) -- the real clustering key
operations is strongly consistent (append must be durable before ack) -- Module 00's
"no edit ever silently lost" requirement is non-negotiable here. snapshots and the
documents.latest_seq pointer are eventually consistent: a stale one just means a
slightly longer catch-up, never a wrong document.
